test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If 15 August 2006 is a Tuesday, then what will the day of the week on 7 September 2017 ?
solution: Given: **15 August 2006** was Tuesday. Now, 2006 to 2017 = 11 Years (8 Ordinary Year and 3 Leap Year). And, In 11 Years = 3 Leap years and 8 Ordinary Year. So, 3 Leap Year has 6 odd days, And, 8 Ordinary Year has 8 odd days. Total odd days = 6 + 8 = 14.
